text: @local/dsh-project-board 是供 DSH Web 使用的项目进度看板，在侧边栏展示按状态划分的项目列。它根据会话、Git、文件修改和任务卡片活动计算项目最近动静，并按久未活动程度排序；用户可拖动项目改状态、创建项目、添加素材，也可单击项目继续最近会话。适合同时跟进代码和素材项目的人。描述改写通过 DSH Host 的默认模型服务处理，其他功能读取本地项目及 DSH 数据。

@local/dsh-project-board adds a project board to the DSH Web sidebar. It groups projects by status and estimates activity from sessions, Git, files, and task cards. Users can drag to change status, create projects, add materials, or open a recent session.
想在 DSH Web 侧边栏看所有项目最近什么时候动过。
能不能拖动看板上的项目卡片来更新项目状态？
我想从项目列表直接回到上次工作的 DSH 会话。
@local/dsh-project-board 的功能「活动时间看板」：在 DSH Web 侧栏按状态展示项目，并综合会话、Git、文件与任务卡片活动估算最近动静。打开看板即可查看排序后的项目。
@local/dsh-project-board 的功能「项目状态与跳转」：用户拖动项目到另一状态列后写回项目数据；单击项目则查询对应工作区和最近会话，供客户端继续进入项目。
@local/dsh-project-board 使用描述改写时，会把项目名、类型和用户描述提交给 DSH Host 的默认模型服务；提供方由默认模型路由选择，插件未固定服务域名或密钥名。

@local/dsh-project-board README · 项目进度看板 · dsh-project-board：DSH Web 侧边栏里的**原生**项目看板：五列按状态分，**天数只读机器时间**，拖动改状态直接写回
`projects.yaml`，单击就进那个项目继续开发。

@local/dsh-project-board README · 它解决什么：任务看板管的是「一件事」，没有卡就什么都不显示。这里管的是「一个项目」：

- **项目永远在**，哪怕它一张卡都没有。
- **不用你维护时间**。天数是算出来的，取四个证据里最新的那个：
  DSH 会话记录 · git 提交（含未提交改动的文件 mtime）· 目录里最新文件改动 · 任务看板卡片执行时间。
- **首屏永远是最该动的那个**。按「最久没动」排序，不是按你上次想改的顺序。

它不统计百分比，不做甘特图，也不在面板里写 `intent` / `next`——那两句是你和 agent 说话时改的。

@local/dsh-project-board README · 装：前置：`dsh web` 已经能跑，用 `web` profile。

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/sunzhiyueaa/dsh-project-board.git D:\dsh-plugins\dsh-project-board
cd D:\dsh-plugins\dsh-project-board
copy projects.example.yaml projects.yaml     # 然后填你自己的项目
dsh plugin --profile web add link:D:\dsh-plugins\dsh-project-board

**装完要重启 `dsh web`**：客户端插件清单每个进程只扫一次，不重启侧边栏不会出现这一行。
之后改 `lib/client.js` 只需刷新页面；改 `package.json` 的 `dsh.client` 才需要再重启。

侧边栏出现「项目进度」，点它就是这张板。
@local/dsh-project-board README · 2. 单击 → 进这个项目：打开它最后一次会话继续干活；没有会话就新建一个工作区 + 会话。

@local/dsh-project-board README · 3. 新增项目：右上角「+ 新增项目」。名称和「要干的内容」必填，其余可以以后补。
描述可以口语气，点「让 AI 改写」压成一句。

- **类型**：代码 / 素材——决定状态词表和素材往哪放。
- **素材**：多选文件，落到 `<项目路径>/素材/`（没有路径时落到插件的 `materials/<id>/`）。
- **路径**：给了路径才算得出「多久没动」。

@local/dsh-project-board README · 数据文件：只有一份：`projects.yaml`，放在插件目录下。

```yaml
settings:
  staleDays: 5       # 超过这么多天没动静 → 黄
  zombieDays: 14     # 超过这么多天 → 红
  wipSoftLimit: 3    # 「在做」超过这个数，列头变黄提醒（只是提醒）

人只写三样：`intent`、`next`、`status`（可选 `stage` 自由文本）。**不要手写时间戳**——那是机器算的。

状态词表故意按 `kind` 分两套：

| kind | 列 | 状态 |
|---|---|---|
| `code` | 在做 / 卡住 / 搁置 / 已完成 / 认账不做 | `building` / `blocked` / `paused` / `shipped` / `shelved` |
| `material` | 在做 / 卡住 / 搁置 / 已完成 / 认账不做 | `editing` / `blocked` / `paused` / `exported` / `shelved` |

@local/dsh-project-board README · 数据文件：`paused` 是「先停下，还会回来」；`shelved` 是「这事我不做了」。`shelved` 不删记录，
它照样在板上，只是不再是你的负担。

@local/dsh-project-board README · 红黄绿怎么来的：```
最后动静 = max(最后会话时间, 最后 git 提交, 目录内最新文件改动, 最后一张卡的执行时间)
```

- 超过 `staleDays`（默认 5 天）→ 黄
- 超过 `zombieDays`（默认 14 天）→ 红
- 卡在 14 天那根红刻度上，一条 0–30 天的微条告诉你「离被忘掉还有多久」

这个判定**和你写的 `status` 完全无关**。所以你不会因为「忘了更新状态」而看不到真相。

@local/dsh-project-board README · 几个设计取舍：- **颜色只编码时间，不编码状态**。状态已经写在列名上了，再染一遍颜色等于说两遍。
- **不做百分比**。项目进度没有分母，百分比只是让人安心的装饰。
- **面板只读，除了状态**。`intent` / `next` 由你和 agent 对话时改——那是需要思考的两句话，
  不该在输入框里顺手敲。
- **打开不等人**：宿主持有 15 秒缓存并在后台补算，客户端把上次结果存在 `localStorage` 先画出来。
  实测点开到第一张卡 41 ms。

@local/dsh-project-board README · 目录结构：```
lib/host/index.js     路由、缓存、stale-while-revalidate、预热
lib/host/evidence.js  证据折叠：会话索引 / git / 文件 mtime / 看板卡片
lib/host/edit.js      yaml 行级改写（保留注释）、新建项目、素材落盘
lib/host/ai.js        描述改写（一次 llm 调用，45 秒超时）

@local/dsh-project-board README · 已知限制：- 客户端插件清单**每个 `dsh web` 进程只扫一次**，新装或改 `dsh.client` 必须重启。
- Windows 上起 git 子进程很贵，所以 git 结果按路径缓存 20 秒，并行折叠。
- 写完 yaml 后面板自己刷新；外部改文件最多等 15 秒（或者点「刷新」）。
- 面板不写 `intent` / `next`，这是故意的。

@local/dsh-project-board README · dsh-project-board：A **native** project board that lives in the DSH Web sidebar. Five columns by status,
**the day count is read from machine evidence only**, drag a card to change its status
(written straight back to `projects.yaml`), click a card to jump back into that project.

English · [中文](README.md)

---
@local/dsh-project-board README · What it is for：A task board is about *one task*: no card, nothing shows. This is about *one project*:

@local/dsh-project-board README · What it is for：- **Projects are always there**, even with zero cards.
- **You never maintain the clock.** "Days" is computed from the newest of four signals:
  DSH session records · git commits (plus mtimes of uncommitted files) · newest file change
  in the directory · task-board card activity.
- **The first screen is always the thing you should touch next.** Sorted by "longest untouched",
  not by the order you happened to edit them.

@local/dsh-project-board README · What it is for：No percentages, no Gantt, and the panel never writes `intent` / `next` — those two sentences
get edited while you talk to the agent.

@local/dsh-project-board README · Install：Requires a working `dsh web` with the `web` profile.

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/sunzhiyueaa/dsh-project-board.git D:\dsh-plugins\dsh-project-board
cd D:\dsh-plugins\dsh-project-board
copy projects.example.yaml projects.yaml     # then put your own projects in
dsh plugin --profile web add link:D:\dsh-plugins\dsh-project-board

@local/dsh-project-board README · Drag → change status：Drop a card on another column and the status is written back to `projects.yaml`
(undo available for 4 seconds).

The column decides the word: `code` dropped on "doing" becomes `building`, `material`
dropped on "doing" becomes `editing`. Nothing is written until you let go.
@local/dsh-project-board README · Click → continue that project：Opens its most recent session, or creates a workspace + session if there is none.

@local/dsh-project-board README · New project："+ 新增项目" in the top right. Name and "what to do" are required; the rest can wait.
The description can be written casually — "让 AI 改写" compresses it into one sentence.

- **Type**: code / material — decides the status vocabulary and where materials go.
- **Materials**: multi-select files, stored under `<project path>/素材/`.
- **Path**: without it the board cannot compute "untouched for N days".

@local/dsh-project-board README · The data file：One file, `projects.yaml`, next to the plugin.

```yaml
settings:
  staleDays: 5       # untouched longer than this → amber
  zombieDays: 14     # untouched longer than this → red
  wipSoftLimit: 3    # more than this many in "doing" → column header turns amber

Humans write three things: `intent`, `next`, `status` (plus an optional free-text `stage`).
**Never write timestamps** — those are evidence.

Two status vocabularies, on purpose:

@local/dsh-project-board README · The data file：| kind | columns | statuses |
|---|---|---|
| `code` | doing / blocked / paused / done / shelved | `building` / `blocked` / `paused` / `shipped` / `shelved` |
| `material` | doing / blocked / paused / done / shelved | `editing` / `blocked` / `paused` / `exported` / `shelved` |

`paused` means "stopped, coming back"; `shelved` means "I am not doing this". Shelved
projects stay on the board — they just stop being your problem.

@local/dsh-project-board README · How the colours are computed：```
last touched = max(last session, last git commit, newest file mtime, last card activity)
```

- older than `staleDays` (5) → amber
- older than `zombieDays` (14) → red
- a 0–30 day bar with a red tick at 14 days shows how close a project is to being forgotten

This is **completely independent of the `status` you wrote**. Forgetting to update a status
never hides the truth.

@local/dsh-project-board README · Design choices：- **Colour encodes time, not status.** Status is already the column name; painting it twice
  says nothing new.
- **No percentages.** A project has no denominator; a progress bar is decoration that
  reassures you.
- **Read-only except status.** `intent` / `next` are edited in conversation because they
  need thinking, not typing into a form.
- **Opening never waits.** The host keeps a 15 s cache and revalidates in the background;
  the client paints the previous snapshot from `localStorage` first.
  Measured: 41 ms from click to first card.

@local/dsh-project-board README · Layout：```
lib/host/index.js     routes, cache, stale-while-revalidate, warm-up
lib/host/evidence.js  evidence folding: sessions / git / file mtimes / board cards
lib/host/edit.js      line-level yaml rewrite (comments preserved), new project, materials
lib/host/ai.js        description rewrite (one llm call, 45 s timeout)

@local/dsh-project-board README · Known limits：- The client plugin manifest is scanned **once per `dsh web` process** — installing it or
  changing `dsh.client` requires a restart.
- Spawning git on Windows is expensive, so git results are cached per path for 20 s and all
  projects are folded in parallel.
- After a write the panel refreshes itself; an external edit takes up to 15 s (or hit 刷新).
- The panel never writes `intent` / `next`. On purpose.
